assets.source: src/scene/Diorama.tsx + src/scene/interaction.ts + src/scene/tabletop.ts + src/scene/world-ui.ts + src/scene/characters.ts + src/scene/cartoon-hands.ts + src/scene/zone-input.ts + src/scene/camera-motion.ts + src/scene/vector-motion.ts + src/scene/pointer-lock.ts + src/scene/table-layout.ts + src/scene/board-layout.ts + src/scene/board-europe-layout.ts + src/scene/board-layout-fallback.ts + src/scene/board-print.ts + src/scene/board-pick-targets.ts + src/scene/board-picking.ts + src/scene/rail-miniatures.ts + src/scene/rail-batching.ts + src/scene/player-reserve.ts + src/scene/card-art.ts + src/scene/europe-atlas.ts + src/data/europe-geography.ts + src/data/europe.ts + src/ui/rules-pages.ts
assets.license: project original procedural geometry and artwork; Natural Earth public-domain geodata; classic Europe graph and ticket facts with sources in docs/europe-rules.md
assets.transformations: Original rounded Three.js coach bodies, barrel roofs, windows, bogies, wheels, couplers and brass trim; instanced route pieces and physical 45-coach reserve; geographic atlas with 47 locally spread city positions and explicit name leaders, 101 curved routes, separated double tracks and 299 physical places; station reservations and four printed connector gaps; shared ink paths for printing, highlighting, bounded picking and SVG fallback with physical mesh priority; original vector wagon-card and locomotive artwork; separate stock tray, physical tickets and clipboard; vector-based option and collection gestures across the gameplay canvas and visible-pointer board zoom/pan; self-hosted IBM Plex typography; no publisher scans, artwork or logos imported; tutorial focus restrictions, explicit turn confirmation and frame-time-aware base camera transitions with bounded decaying mouse-look overlay; current-camera raycasts and press stabilization; reduced-motion and stale-input reset handling; four original short cartoon railway characters inspired by the selected Fisherman form reference; continuous anatomical five-finger hands with independent 22-bone skeletons, normalized skin weights, mirrored deformation, quaternion animation clips and card-following foreground grips; closed sculpted heads integrating cheeks, chin, nose, eye sockets, eyelids and lips; true browser Pointer Lock from an explicit acquisition-only click, single relative mousemove stream, release on Escape/mode/lifecycle changes, visible cursor and keyboard on refusal; 15 non-cyclic rules pages with eight original 900x540 PNG diagrams and preserved text exceptions, DOM SVG counterparts, late-load CanvasTexture disposal guards
assets.hashKind: sha256 of ordered file name + LF + file bytes + LF for each source
